kc20.definition: Order of Operations is the conventional hierarchy for evaluating arithmetic expressions involving addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and parentheses with positive real numbers.

kc21.name: Order of Operations All
kc21.definition: The set of rules determining the sequence for evaluating mathematical expressions, prioritizing operations like parentheses, exponents, multiplication, division, addition, and subtraction.

kc27.name: Ordering Positive Decimals
kc27.definition: Ordering positive decimals is arranging decimal numbers greater than zero from least to greatest or greatest to least by comparing place values.

kc28.name: Ordering Positive Decimals
kc28.definition: Ordering positive decimals is arranging decimal numbers greater than zero by comparing their place values from left to right.

kc29.name: Ordering Fractions
kc29.definition: Ordering fractions is the ability to arrange a set of fractions in ascending or descending sequence based on their numerical value.

kc30.name: Ordering Integers
kc30.definition: Ordering integers is arranging whole numbers from least to greatest or greatest to least based on their value on the number line.

kc31.name: Rounding
kc31.definition: Rounding is the process of approximating a numerical value to a specified degree of precision, typically to a nearby place value.

kc34.name: Division Fractions

kc35.name: Estimation
kc35.definition: Estimation is the cognitive skill of approximating a value or quantity using reasoning, prior knowledge, and contextual cues.

kc36.name: Least Common Multiple
kc36.definition: The smallest positive integer that is a multiple of two or more given integers.

kc37.name: Multiplication Fractions
kc37.definition: Multiplication of fractions is the operation of finding the product of two or more fractional numbers by multiplying numerators and denominators.

kc38.name: Percent Of
kc38.definition: Percent Of: A ratio comparing a specific quantity to a total of one hundred, representing the relative size of a part.

kc39.name: Subtraction Whole Numbers
kc39.definition: Subtraction of whole numbers is the arithmetic operation of finding the difference between two non-negative integers.

kc40.name: Square Root

kc43.name: Proportion

kc48.name: Exponents
